name: Gratin de Blettes

ingredients.name: Swiss chard, stems and leaves separated

steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Wash chard thoroughly. Cut stems into 1 cm pieces and roughly chop leaves, keeping them separate because the stems take longer to cook.
Blanch stems in boiling water 5 minutes, add leaves for the last 2 minutes, then drain and squeeze out as much water as possible. Spread in a buttered baking dish.
Melt 35 g butter in a saucepan and soften onion for 5 minutes. Add flour and stir 1 minute, then whisk in milk gradually; simmer 4 minutes until thick and smooth.
Season the béchamel with nutmeg, salt and pepper and stir in half the vegetarian cheese. Pour over the chard, gently lifting the vegetables so sauce reaches underneath.
Mix breadcrumbs with remaining cheese and 15 g melted butter and scatter over the dish. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling and golden, then rest 8 minutes before serving.
tips: Cook chard stems before leaves and squeeze both thoroughly; excess water makes the béchamel gratin thin. Use clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
